GDAA addenda incl. Security Deposit Waiver (YES checked, $69/month in lieu of $3,500), Tenant Benefit Package (Plan A $36 / Plan B $29), tenant charges schedule (posting fee $35 etc.).

lease.lease_break_terms: No tenant early-termination right (para 28). On default (para 27B): unpaid rents for remainder of lease accelerated; tenant liable for lost rent, reletting costs (leasing/advertising fees), repairs, eviction costs/attorney fees, collection costs. Holdover rent 3x daily rent.

notes: TXR-2216 itemization signed 09/07/2022 (PURE Operating LLC for GDAA). No deposit tendered (blank). Line (1) 4,671.04 = maintenance 4,500 + rekey 171.04; line (2) 1,536.01 carpet pad/vinyl repair; no vendor invoices or photos in folder. Accelerated rent per lease para 27B(2) for 09/01/2022-03/09/2023 plus a full month reletting charge. Eviction implied by line 14. 'Renters choice program' $138 inferred = 2 months of $69 SD waiver fee; 'tenant benefit program' $72 = 2 x $36 Plan A. First full month April 2022; no ledger so payment history unknown. Lease file and addendum file are near-identical sizes (same envelope).
